text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went to watch the futsal tournament held at Tracen Academy,
I happened upon Sakura Laurel.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we're aiming for victory
as Team <Japanese Black Wagyu>!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
If we win first place, we get top-grade Japanese Black Wagyu☆
So generous, it's marvelous★!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Even I was shocked when Brian invited me,
but no wonder she bit so hard!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I was told we needed five people.
Not that it matters. I will crush them all myself.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! Wait up, Brian-san!
Maya wants to shoot too~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so the tournament began.
Thanks to the sheer raw talent of its members, Team <Japanese Black Wagyu>—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Scored goal after goal,
sailing smoothly through each match!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, once they reached the finals—

text_block_list.name: Opponent A
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you got lucky making it this far, but this is the end...
You're up against seasoned veterans like us!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ghk, she blew past me—!
Laurel, holding the defense is on you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Ngh—!
choice_data_list: Ah, they gave up the opening goal...!

text_block_list.name: Opponent A
text_block_list.text:
Aww, is that all you've got? Playing such a boring match is no fun...
Tell you what! Want us to pull our goalkeeper for you?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Muuu! Going easy on us
doesn't make me happy one bit!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You sure talk big.
Thanks to you, I'm getting fired up...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, even when they got possession of the ball,
it was easily stripped away, leaving them unable to take a single shot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reason was obvious—everyone was trying to score on their own,
making their movements entirely monotonous.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(Every single one of them is amazing on their own,
but none of it is working together...!
At this rate, it's just like—)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Just like... we're all fighting separate battles—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's not just simple addition—
when you multiply everyone's efforts, it turns into massive power!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I get it now...! Referee, time-out please!
Everyone, let's have a strategy meeting!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I have a suggestion—let's make Brian-chan
the only one who takes shots.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The other three will focus solely on passing
and getting the ball to Brian-chan.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! Why, Laurel-san?!
Maya is confident in her shooting too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know.
I know Maya-chan's shooting is amazing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: But... if we do that, it's just simple "addition."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: True teamwork isn't just adding strength together.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
When each person works hard to contribute for the team's sake,
that's when our power truly "multiplies."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
We all share the exact same desire to win, right?
Then—let's unite that feeling as one!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You sure know how to give a passionate speech, Laurel!
In that case, lead the team—
leave the goal to me!

text_block_list.name: Opponent A
text_block_list.text:
Ha! I don't know what you were talking about,
but thanks for wasting your time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —Maya-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nice pass, Laurel-san!
Then next is—Mabe-chin!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous pop-up☆
Brian, finish it off★!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph—!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Nice shot,
Brian-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...The ball was passed to the perfect spot, that's all.
I simply kicked it with everything I had.

text_block_list.name: Opponent A
text_block_list.text:
W-Where did this combination play suddenly come from...!
Dammit, keeper, don't let your guard down!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, we'll show you our team play.
The real match starts now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unleashing their teamwork, Sakura Laurel and her squad played spectacularly,
until finally the ending whistle echoed across the court—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeahhh!! We won
by an overwhelming margin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Right, all that's left is to eat the Japanese Black Wagyu.
I'll leave how to cook it up to you guys.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Since it's something we won by joining forces together,
I'm sure it's going to taste incredible!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
To think we actually won the championship...
It's all because our team came together as one, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yay~! It was only by one point,
but Maya and the team won!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Laurel, that was amazing☆ Winning as a team
is this marvelous★!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly! With teamwork,
there's nothing we can't overcome!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: We really are the strongest team, aren't we♪
